transcript: I responded to a domestic disturbance, the male shoved me and I took him to the ground with a control hold and cuffed him.
note: Officers use the agency force continuum terminology, not the vague phrase 'physical force'.

transcript: I read him his rights at the scene before transport.
corrected: Yes - Miranda advised verbally at scene prior to questioning
note: Miranda field should state it was given prior to custodial interrogation.

transcript: Driver failed the field sobriety tests and blew a 0.13 on the preliminary breath test, arrested for DUI.
corrected: VC 23152(a) - Driving Under the Influence of Alcohol
note: Charges should reference the statutory vehicle/penal code section, not just the plain-language offense.

transcript: Suspect grabbed two cases of beer and a carton of cigarettes and walked out, loss about ninety dollars.
note: Classify theft by statutory threshold (petty vs grand) based on stated loss value.

transcript: I called for medical and they checked the subject out at the scene, he refused transport.
corrected: EMS responded, subject evaluated on scene, refused transport (signed AMA)
note: Medical attention field should capture EMS response, evaluation, and refusal/transport disposition.
